_about: Every number the proposal and the README quote, with its baseline date and how to reproduce it. tests/check-claims.py fails the build when a listed file states a different value, or uses a refused phrase. Run it with --final before submission to also recompute the live numbers and the upstream counts. In the proposal text, write each moving number with its date and say that it moves: 'as of <date>, and this figure moves as upstream does.'
